Hi Marissa,

We're finishing our vendor review for the ValoraPay integration and need a couple of items to complete the privacy section: 1) a full list of current subprocessors (with countries/jurisdictions) and 2) a field-level mapping for CRM exports that shows which customer fields are exported to each partner (PII / non-PII classification).

We routinely get asked about retention windows and whether any of the exports transit through non-EU/US jurisdictions — can you confirm overall cross-border transfer controls?

Attached is our standard request form (subprocessor_roster_request_form.pdf) — if you can return the roster + mapping or point us to a secure location with the documents, that would be great. If needed, a short call this week to walk through would help.

Short answer: yes, we can provide a current subprocessors roster and a redacted field-level mapping for the CRM export paths. A couple of items up front so we scope this correctly:

- Do you need the mapping at the table/column level or a flattened CSV that maps customer-facing field names to processor recipients?
- Are you comfortable with redacted sample exports (we can remove values and show header/field types) rather than full production samples?
- We will flag any processors that rely on cross-border transit (e.g., analytics relay in APAC) and include our mitigation notes (onshore fallback, encryption-in-transit, SCCs where applicable).

I'll loop in Kim (Legal) to confirm the level of detail we can include and Ben (Security) to prepare the evidence packet. Can we aim to deliver an initial packet by Thursday EOD PT? If that works, I'll push the files to a secure Drive link and send an access note plus a DocuSign/CSV if you require signed attestations.

Marissa — quick internal note before we send anything externally:

- We should provide the roster as an export from our vendor registry (vendor roster CSV) with columns: vendor_name, role, country, contract_signed_date, data_categories, SCCs_applied (yes/no), onshore_fallback (yes/no).
- For the field mapping: provide a redacted CSV that lists field_name, pii_flag (yes/no), recipient_processor(s) — do not include any actual customer values.
- Include a short narrative (1 page) describing cross-border safeguards and our default retention windows for CRM exports.
- Ask Fintegral if they want our SOC2 report snapshot; if so we'll provide a redacted copy via secure link.

I'll prepare the template and sign-off on the narrative. Ben — please assemble the export of the vendor roster and highlight any processors with APAC transit so we can call out mitigations.
